radiofm.configuration.allowPrivateNetwor: Let radios reach addresses inside the server's own network. The link is typed in by a player but fetched by the server, so turn this on only when the music sits on that same network
radiofm.configuration.maxActiveRadios.to: How many radios may play at once across the whole server. The per-player cap is the game rule radiofm:max
How many tracks to take from one playlist
